components.label: Load Balancer
components.note: Terminates inbound HTTPS, routes each request by platform, skips unhealthy instances and keeps returning users on the same server.

components.label: Health Checker
components.note: Probes every backend instance. An instance that fails its probe is excluded from routing until it passes again.

components.label: Instance A1
components.note: Healthy instance in Zone A, receiving traffic.

components.label: Instance A2
components.note: Healthy instance in Zone A, receiving traffic.

components.label: Instance A3
components.note: Failed its last health probe. Excluded from rotation, so no traffic reaches it.

cards.title: Health checks
items: The load balancer only routes to instances that report healthy.

cards.title: Failure handling
items: A3 failed its probe, so traffic is redirected to A1 and A2 and the service stays available.
